title: 第1994章 强者齐出忌惮轮回道尊第1993章 天台上的身影
lines: 第1994章强者齐出，忌惮轮回道尊
天地齐鸣，整个九天雷峰变得有趣了。
山巅下有数以百计的修士，他们都是天之骄子，更有甚者在登天梯，可伴随着天地齐鸣，一股无形的威压从上方狂涌而下。
宛若河堤崩塌，仅仅是一瞬间，无数人的身躯不断从阶梯坠落，他们狼狈不堪，神色惊恐，抬头望着天巅是无尽的惊讶。
“怎么回事？”有人说话间扫视了天台的位置，由于他的实力不足，无法知道天台存在绝世无双的身影，但是他却从中感受到可怕的五行之力，“难道这是陈默成就帝尊之进境，方有如此可怕的威压？”
“但他才刚刚成就主神，不可能这么快拥有帝尊之境。”
其余人虽然没有这个心思。
但是他们不相信陈默会有帝尊之境，却无法解释此刻天台的情况。
这一刻，所有登上阶梯之上纷纷滚落山底，他们的神色惊恐之余同样有疑惑的目光，那怕是燕倾城等人也有这种方法。
嗡嗡嗡！
就在这时，天台之上忽然有五颜六色的光华升腾爆发。
轰隆一声，整个天穹宛若炸开一般，直接呈现出一道黝黑无尽的大漩涡。
这漩涡吞噬来自四面八方的力量，使得这里的神力不断消散。
甚至大量的修士都感觉自己的生命之力被剥夺。
他们神色充满无尽的惊恐，皆是开始往四面八方逃跑。
“不……我还不想死，谁来救我一命。”
不止是一人喊出救命，其余人也是这样，那怕是燕倾城等人的生命之力也在消散，境界开始下坠，仅仅是一霎那，燕倾城原本那上位神的战斗力坠落到仙尊之境。
与此同时，冰河和凌晴雪的修为同样在下降。
“这究竟发生了什么？“冰河神色诧异，目光划过一抹恐惧之色
“为何突然之间，会有这位可怕的吞噬之力？”
凌晴雪摇摇头，却也自我安慰道：“冰河，或许这就是小师弟要突破帝尊之境，周围神力不足，才会剥走我们体内的神力。“
“希望如此吧！”
冰河无奈叹息，眸子闪动之际看向天台，但是天台之上只有五颜六色的光华和大漩涡，吞噬之力正是来自大漩涡。
见到这一幕，冰河心头有些不妙，“三师姐，可能这不是小师弟突破帝尊之境，而是天台之上出现了大问题。”
“什么？”
听到冰河的话，凌晴雪和燕倾城等人的神色顿时变得紧张了。
“以我天机算术，测算天机，断命运。”
梁霏芸念念有词，十指紧扣之际有玄光升腾，霎那间便是划破长空，使得其余人纷纷下意识看向梁霏芸，“怎么样？”
听了这话，梁霏芸的脸色有些苍白，“我无法推算到陈默现在的状况，不过我擦觉到他气运衰弱，这是大事不妙的迹象。”
content_en:
Chapter 1994 The strong ones come out to fear the Taoist Lord of Reincarnation
The heaven and the earth roared together, and the entire Nine Heavens Thunder Peak became interesting.
There are hundreds of monks at the top of the mountain. They are all the proud ones of heaven. Some of them are even climbing the ladder to heaven. But as the heaven and the earth roar together, an invisible coercion surges down from above.
Just like the river embankment collapsed, just for a moment, countless people's bodies continued to fall from the stairs. They were in a state of disarray and looked horrified. They looked up at the top of the sky in endless surprise.
"What's going on?" Someone glanced at the location of the rooftop as he spoke. Due to his lack of strength, he could not know that there was an unparalleled figure on the rooftop, but he felt the terrifying power of the Five Elements from it. "Is it possible that this is Chen Mo's entry into the emperor's realm, so he has such terrifying pressure?"
"But he has just become the Lord God, and it is impossible for him to reach the realm of Emperor Sovereign so quickly."
Although the rest of the people don't have this intention.
However, they did not believe that Chen Mo would reach the realm of emperor, but they could not explain the situation on the rooftop at this moment.
At this moment, everyone who climbed up the stairs rolled down to the bottom of the mountain one after another. Their expressions were frightened but also suspicious. Even Yan Qingcheng and others also had this method.
Buzz!
At this moment, colorful brilliance suddenly rose and exploded on the rooftop.
With a roar, the entire sky seemed to explode, directly showing a dark and endless large whirlpool.
This whirlpool swallows power from all directions, causing the divine power here to continue to dissipate.
Even a large number of monks feel that their life force has been deprived.
Their expressions were filled with endless fear, and they all began to run away in all directions.
"No... I don't want to die yet. Someone come and save my life."
Not only one person shouted for help, but the others also did the same. Even the life force of Yan Qingcheng and others was dissipating, and their realm began to decline. In just an instant, Yan Qingcheng's original fighting power of a superior god fell to the realm of the immortal.
At the same time, Binghe and Ling Qingxue's cultivation levels were also declining.
"What on earth happened?" Binghe looked surprised, a look of fear flashed across his eyes.
"Why is there suddenly this terrifying devouring power?"
Ling Qingxue shook her head, but she comforted herself and said, "Binghe, maybe this is because my junior brother wants to break through to the realm of Emperor, and the surrounding divine power is insufficient, so the divine power in our bodies will be stripped away."
"I hope so!"
Binghe sighed helplessly and looked towards the rooftop with flashing eyes, but there were only colorful lights and large whirlpools on the rooftop, and the devouring power came from the large whirlpool.
Seeing this scene, Binghe felt a little unhappy, "Third Senior Sister, maybe this is not the Junior Brother's breakthrough to the Emperor's Realm, but a big problem on the rooftop."
"What?"
After hearing Binghe's words, Ling Qingxue, Yan Qingcheng and others suddenly became nervous.
"Use my heavenly arithmetic to calculate heavenly secrets and determine destiny."
Liang Feiyun muttered something, and as she clasped her fingers together, a mysterious light rose up, and instantly cut through the sky, causing the others to subconsciously look at Liang Feiyun, "How is it?"
After hearing this, Liang Feiyun's face turned a little pale, "I can't predict Chen Mo's current situation, but I feel that his luck is weakening. This is a sign that something is wrong."
title_en: Chapter 1994 The strong men come out to fear the Taoist Master of Samsara Chapter 1993 The figure on the rooftop
